text:
Cameron Crotty is Vancouver's newest defenseman, claimed off waivers from Minnesota last week. He's 27, a 2017 third-round pick who has played for four NHL organisations in 13 games, and The Hockey News quoted him calling it "another opportunity in this league." He's played two games for the Canucks, including Sunday's win in Vegas that ended the losing streak.

There's very little NHL sample to go on: five games this season between Minnesota and Vancouver, about 11 minutes a night, no points and one shot on goal. His teams have taken about 49% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on, which on this Vancouver team is an improvement. Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis noted, with a heavy caveat about sample size, that he has never been on the ice for a power-play goal against in his career.

His last full AHL season, in Tucson, translated to about 8 points over 82 NHL games. He's a depth defenseman on a team that needs bodies, and our talent range has him under 10 points over the rest of the year. The opportunity is real on a rebuilding blue line. What he does with it is the only story here.
